stories.title: 13 Indian stocks post five‑day winning streak, each up over 27%
stories.summary: The Economic Times reported that 13 stocks listed on Indian exchanges each recorded gains for five consecutive trading sessions, with every stock rising more than 27% over that period. The report highlighted the sustained upward momentum across the group.
stories.why: The broad, simultaneous price gains suggest strong short‑term momentum that may attract traders focused on price trends.

stories.title: India and Finland aim to deepen economic ties via startup cooperation
stories.summary: Finnish Ambassador Mikko Kivikoski said India and Finland are working to deepen economic ties by focusing on collaboration with Indian startups. The initiative was highlighted at the Polar Bear Pitching event, where startup founder Yash Goliya was selected to represent India in a global competition scheduled for 2027. Bilateral trade between the two countries has been growing significantly and sharply over the past decade.
stories.why: The cooperation is intended to promote Finnish investment in Indian startups and give Finnish firms access to the Indian market.

stories.title: Max Healthcare, Deepak Fertilisers among 10 stocks that gained up to 14% in a week
stories.summary: Economic Times reported that Max Healthcare and Deepak Fertilisers were among ten Indian stocks that rose as much as 14% over the past week. The item names only those two companies and does not identify the other eight gainers or explain what drove the moves, so it documents short-term price strength without establishing a cause.
stories.why: It flags recent Indian equity outperformers for monitoring, but with only two names and no stated catalyst it is not sufficient on its own to act on.
